evidence: Exact rational maxima and minima including both complements checked over 3,417 integer side triples in [1,33], including 91 instances with a=s/2. These are corroboration; the quadratic and continuity arguments cover all Euclidean triangles in scope.
correctness.rationale: Each side is shorter than the semiperimeter s, so two points separated by s lie on different sides and a cap at their shared vertex has side distances x,s−x and fraction x(s−x)/(uv), with x between s−v and u. The maximal cap on a pair is obtained by projecting s/2 onto this interval. For a>=s/2 every pair contains the midpoint, so (a,b) gives the largest cap. Otherwise a+b>s gives b,c>s/2, and the (a,b) endpoint (s−a)/b dominates the (a,c) endpoint and the (b,c) centered cap; 4c(s−a)>s². The vertex-passing endpoint values are (s−v)/u over ordered pairs. Their least value is (s−c)/b: the only possible competing ratio involving the larger denominator c is bounded below by (s−b)/c, and b(s−b)>=c(s−c) since b,c>s/2. The maximal complement thus has fraction (s−a)/b and cannot exceed the maximal cap (in the first branch the difference is (s−2a)²/(4ab)). The two formulas agree at a=s/2. Oriented antipodal chords depend continuously on the circle of boundary starts; exchanging endpoints complements the fraction, giving the full interval. In the first regime ab<=a(2s−a)/2<=4s²/9 with equality only equilateral. In the second regime (s−a)/b>2/3. Every cap leaves positive area on the other side because it cannot use both entire sides; compactness yields M<1. As a/s goes to zero, b/s lies between 1−a/s and 1, so M tends to 1. This does not assert that other degenerating sequences cannot approach 1.

value.rationale: An equipartition line gives equality of area and perimeter, but it supplies no quantitative control when varying all perimeter-halving chords. The exact set of possible area ratios, a sharp rigid obstruction to uniformly small deviation in triangles, and the change from an interior vertex cap to a vertex-passing line are reusable information about the natural bisection family. This is a complete family classification rather than a repackaging of the exact equalizer problem.
residual_risks: Elementary and triangle-specific; no general convex-body extremal statement or probabilistic area law claimed.
